explanation: This unit tracks how strongly the agent currently favors a2. While it keeps choosing a2 it stays at 8-10 at every step (D1 is 10 after a reward and 9 after no reward), but while it keeps choosing a1 it sits at 0-1 during GO and D2, rising only at D1 to about 3-5 after a reward (up to 8 after a long rewarded a1 streak) and 0 after no reward; it slides toward the middle (about 4-7) during switches or after a run of unrewarded a2 trials, and at D2 it is about 2 higher when a rare transition (reaching S2) follows choosing a1.
